@xstate/test | Stately Search ⌘ K Docs API Studio Editor Discover Blog XState v6 alpha Get Started Core Concepts State Machines Actors Agents Guides XState Store Packages XState React XState Vue XState Svelte XState Graph XState Test Agent Graph SDK CLI MCP Developer Tools Stately Studio Glossary Self-hosting XState Test Packages @xstate/test Model-based testing utilities for XState. Copy Markdown Open The latest version of the model-based testing utilities (prev.  @xstate/test ) are now part of the latest  @xstate/graph  package. Documentation for  @xstate/graph  (including the testing utilities) is coming soon; the documentation below is for  @xstate/test@beta . 
 The  @xstate/test package  contains utilities for facilitating  model-based testing  for any software. 
 Watch the talk :  Write Fewer Tests! From Automation to Autogeneration  at React Rally 2019 ( 🎥 Video ) 
 Quick start Copy Anchor Link 
 
 Install  xstate  and  @xstate/test : 
 
 Copy Text npm  install  xstate  @xstate/test 
 
 Create the machine that will be used to model the system under test (SUT): 
 
 Copy Text import  { createMachine }  from  'xstate' ; 
 
 const  toggleMachine  =  createMachine ({ 
   id:  'toggle' , 
   initial:  'inactive' , 
   states: { 
     inactive: { 
       on: { 
         TOGGLE:  'active' , 
       }, 
     }, 
     active: { 
       on: { 
         TOGGLE:  'inactive' , 
       }, 
     }, 
   }, 
 }); 
 
 Add assertions for each state in the machine (in this example, using  Puppeteer ): 
 
 Copy Text // ... 
 
 const  toggleMachine  =  createMachine ({ 
   id:  'toggle' , 
   initial:  'inactive' , 
   states: { 
     inactive: { 
       on: { 
         /* ... */ 
       }, 
       meta: { 
         test :  async  ( page )  =>  { 
           await  page. waitFor ( 'input:checked' ); 
         }, 
       }, 
     }, 
     active: { 
       on: { 
         /* ... */ 
       }, 
       meta: { 
         test :  async  ( page )  =>  { 
           await  page. waitFor ( 'input:not(:checked)' ); 
         }, 
       }, 
     }, 
   }, 
 }); 
 
 Create the model: 
 
 Copy Text import  { createMachine }  from  'xstate' ; 
 import  { createModel }  from  '@xstate/test' ; 
 
 const  toggleMachine  =  createMachine ( /* ... */ ); 
 
 const  toggleModel  =  createModel (toggleMachine). withEvents ({ 
   TOGGLE: { 
     exec :  async  ( page )  =>  { 
       await  page. click ( 'input' ); 
     }, 
   }, 
 }); 
 
 Create test plans and run the tests with coverage: 
 
 Copy Text // ... 
 
 describe ( 'toggle' , ()  =>  { 
   const  testPlans  =  toggleModel. getShortestPathPlans (); 
 
   testPlans. forEach (( plan )  =>  { 
     describe (plan.description, ()  =>  { 
       plan.paths. forEach (( path )  =>  { 
         it (path.description,  async  ()  =>  { 
           // do any setup, then... 
 
           await  path. test (page); 
         }); 
       }); 
     }); 
   }); 
 
   it ( 'should have full coverage' , ()  =>  { 
     return  toggleModel. testCoverage (); 
   }); 
 }); 
 API Copy Anchor Link 
 createModel(machine, options?) Copy Anchor Link 
 Creates an abstract testing model based on the  machine  passed in. 
 Argument Type Description machine StateMachine The machine used to create the abstract model. options? TestModelOptions Options to customize the abstract model 
 Returns Copy Anchor Link 
 A  TestModel  instance. 
 Methods Copy Anchor Link 
 model.withEvents(eventsMap) Copy Anchor Link 
 Provides testing details for each event. Each key in  eventsMap  is an object whose keys are event types and properties describe the execution and test cases for each event: 
 
 exec  (function): Function that executes the events. It is given two arguments: 
 
 testContext  (any): any contextual testing data 
 event  (EventObject): the event sent by the testing model 
 
 
 cases?  (EventObject[]): the sample event objects for this event type that can be sent by the testing model. 
 
 Example: 
 Copy Text const  toggleModel  =  createModel (toggleMachine). withEvents ({ 
   TOGGLE: { 
     exec :  async  ( page )  =>  { 
       await  page. click ( 'input' ); 
     }, 
   }, 
 }); 
 testModel.getShortestPathPlans(options?) Copy Anchor Link 
 Returns an array of testing plans based on the shortest paths from the test model’s initial state to every other reachable state. 
 Options Copy Anchor Link 
 Argument Type Description filter function Takes in the  state  and returns  true  if the state should be traversed, or  false  if traversal should stop. 
 This is useful for preventing infinite traversals and stack overflow errors: 
 Copy Text const  todosModel  =  createModel (todosMachine). withEvents ({ 
   /* ... */ 
 }); 
 
 const  plans  =  todosModel. getShortestPathPlans ({ 
   // Tell the algorithm to limit state/event adjacency map to states 
   // that have less than 5 todos 
   filter : ( state )  =>  state.context.todos. length  <  5 , 
 }); 
 testModel.getSimplePathPlans(options?) Copy Anchor Link 
 Returns an array of testing plans based on the simple paths from the test model’s initial state to every other reachable state. 
 Options Copy Anchor Link 
 Argument Type Description filter function Takes in the  state  and returns  true  if the state should be traversed, or  false  if traversal should stop. 
 testModel.getPlanFromEvents(events, options) Copy Anchor Link 
 Argument Type Description events EventObject[] The sequence of events to create the plan options { target: string } An object with a  target  property that should match the target state of the events 
 Returns an array with a single testing plan with a single path generated from the  events . 
 Throws an error if the last entered state does not match the  options.target . 
 testModel.testCoverage(options?) Copy Anchor Link 
 Tests that all state nodes were covered (traversed) in the exected tests. 
 Options Copy Anchor Link 
 Argument Type Description filter function Takes in each  stateNode  and returns  true  if that state node should have been covered. 
 Copy Text // Only test coverage for state nodes with a `.meta` property defined: 
 
 testModel. testCoverage ({ 
   filter : ( stateNode )  =>  !! stateNode.meta, 
 }); 
 testPlan.description Copy Anchor Link 
 The string description of the testing plan, describing the goal of reaching the  testPlan.state . 
 testPlan.paths Copy Anchor Link 
 The testing paths to get from the test model’s initial state to every other reachable state. 
 testPath.description Copy Anchor Link 
 The string description of the testing path, describing a sequence of events that will reach the  testPath.state . 
 testPath.test(testContext) Copy Anchor Link 
 Executes each step in  testPath.segments  by: 
 
 Verifying that the SUT is in  segment.state 
 Executing the event for  segment.event 
 
 And finally, verifying that the SUT is in the target  testPath.state . 
 NOTE: If your model has nested states, the  meta.test  method for each parent state of that nested state is also executed when verifying that the SUT is in that nested state.
